milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a poppy flower causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no poppy (only a wooden axe), so having ≥1 poppy confirms the mining task is complete. Poppy breaks instantly with any tool or bare hand.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a birch button results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with no birch_button, so having ≥1 confirms successful completion of the crafting chain (birch_log → birch_planks → birch_button). This is preferred over craft_item event tracking because inventory_has is simpler and equally reliable.
